page.layout: One page of title text, centred; a woodcut of a flower vase in the middle; imprint below the vase. Handwritten numeral "2" top right is not printed and is left out.

main_text.l: Per XXX. annos in illustri schola Bremensi
Eloq: Linguae Graecae & Histor. P. P. Celeberrimi
Typis & Impensis HERMANNI BRAUERI, ibidem illustris

page.notes: The woodcut of a flower vase is an illustration with no text. The title lines are set in mixed roman and italic type; italic and roman parts are not marked separately. The printed "Anno M. DC. LXXXIII." is given as printed. The handwritten "2" at top right and the faint pencil mark are not printed text and are omitted.
